summary: Finish assigning org roles, choosing the correct component context (controller or EDA). Removing a user from the organization (Remove user) removes their organization roles, including indirect ones; Manage roles edits direct roles, while inherited team roles are view-only.
questions: What happens to roles when a user is removed from an organization?
How do I manage a user's organization roles?
Can I edit roles a user inherited from a team?
How do I remove a user from an organization?
